newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA BANCOREX SEEKS $75 MLN IN SYNDICATED LOAN.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA BANCOREX SEEKS $75 MLN IN SYNDICATED LOAN.

text.p: Romanian leading state bank Banca Romana de Comert Exterior SA (Bancorex) said on Wednesday it would sign a $75 million syndicated loan accord with London-based Credit Suisse First Boston this week.
The accord will be signed in Bucharest on Thursday, a bank statement said.

Bancorex' press office said CS First Boston would act as lead managers for the loan, which will involve 17 banks. It said other details on the deal would be available after the accord signing ceremony.
Bancorex specialises in foreign trade financing and handles the bulk of foreign exchange trading on the local market.
Romania rejoined international capital markets in 1995, after more than a decade of absence, with syndicated loans for the central bank.
